route.subtitle: Browse registered ObjectTypes, LinkTypes, ActionType safety contracts, and observed Resource instances.
route.unavailable: The ontology explorer route is not wired on this deployment, so no object type or link type is claimed here.

context.ontologyPurpose: The registered ObjectTypes and LinkTypes - the typed vocabulary the control plane reasons over (resources, actions, and the causal links between them). Read-only reference.
context.impactPurpose: Simulates how many resources one action could reach by traversing the resource graph from a target. The safety check caps the impact scope so a single change can never touch more than its scope. Read-only what-if.

objects.neighborhoodHint: Select a neighboring card to move through the one-hop graph. Hover or focus a card to inspect its properties.
objects.invalid: ObjectType {name} is not registered. Choose a type from the directory.

instances.title: Ontology instances
instances.description: Explore one observed Resource instance, its direct incoming and outgoing relationships, and recent durable activity at one inventory cutoff.
instances.authorityHint: Selection and traversal grant no approval, mutation, or execution authority.
instances.inventoryUnavailable: The active inventory projection is unavailable, so no Resource instance is claimed.
instances.detailUnavailable: The selected Resource instance cannot be projected from the active inventory.
instances.resultBound: {count} visible Resources in the active projection
instances.resultBoundTruncated: First {count} Resources in the active projection
instances.noSearchResults: No Resource in the active generation matches this search.
instances.emptyDescription: The workspace will show the selected Resource and its bounded multi-hop neighborhood.
instances.aksCoverageHint: Observed uses stored links only. Unknown and unavailable never imply absence.
instances.networkPathsHint: Only stored edges with reviewed mapping evidence are summarized. Path direction does not rewrite stored edge orientation or prove packet delivery.

networkPathReason.coverage_incomplete: No complete reviewed path reaches this VM in the bounded graph, and relationship coverage is incomplete.
networkPathReason.no_reviewed_path: No complete reviewed path reaches this VM in the bounded graph. Unmodeled backend associations remain unknown.

networkPathKind.direct_public_ip: Direct public IP attachment - {count} stored edges

instances.mapDescription: Bounded depth-{depth} ontology instance graph with {resources} Resources and {links} relationships.
instances.noStateEvidence: No state-bearing audit fact is available for this interval.

truncation.adjacent_edge_limit: the traversal edge bound was reached

instances.relationshipsHint: Select a neighbor to make it the new exploration root.
instances.noRelationships: No direct relationship is recorded in this bounded projection.
instances.timelineHint: Newest-first durable audit facts with exact Resource identity matching. These records are not Azure Activity Log events.
instances.noEvents: No structured FDAI audit activity is recorded for this Resource.
instances.timelineTruncated: The activity list reached its server-owned result bound.
instances.sourcesHint: Availability is reported independently for each source. Missing sources are never replaced with inferred events.
instances.contextPurpose: Read-only exploration of one exact active-inventory Resource, direct relationships, and durable activity evidence.

detail.subtitle: Read-only declaration workbench for one exact ontology release.
detail.notFound: ObjectType {name} is not available to this principal in the active ontology release.
detail.noLifecycleDeclared: No lifecycle contract is declared. Catalog as code remains the declaration authority.
detail.noProvenance: No visible provenance is available for this declaration.
detail.redactedProperties: {count} property field(s) are redacted by the server for the active role or purpose.
detail.actionCoverageIncomplete: Some ActionTypes do not carry an exact semantic target. They are not inferred or shown here.
detail.noRelatedActions: No related ActionType is explicitly declared for this ObjectType.
detail.runtimeImpactDescription: Open the read-only Impact scope view and select one exact Resource target. The bounded traversal preserves stored LinkType direction, depth, and truncation instead of inferring an instance from this declaration.
detail.runtimeImpactUnavailable: Runtime impact is unavailable because this ObjectType has no bound Resource instance source.
detail.dependentsTruncated: The dependent list reached its deterministic result bound.
detail.noDependents: No catalog-topology dependent is recorded for this ObjectType.
detail.noPreviousRelease: No previous retained release is available for comparison.
detail.declarationRefsOnly: Compatibility is based on retained declaration references. Field-level historical schema is not reconstructed.

semantic.title: Operating ontology semantic model
semantic.description: Reviewed ObjectTypes are organized by what FDAI operates, what it protects, what it observes, and how decisions close into outcomes. Catalog meaning is read-only and does not assert runtime state.

bandDescription.operating_scope: What is operated and why it matters
bandDescription.decision_and_learning: Alternatives, execution, outcomes, and reviewed reuse

semantic.noRelationships: No reviewed relationship connects this selection within the semantic model.

stateDescription.execution: Planned, dispatched, verified, or rolled back

map.title: Catalog topology
map.description: All catalog-backed ObjectTypes, InterfaceTypes, FunctionTypes, ResourceTypes, Rules, ActionTypes, Workflows, Agents, SignalTypes, and Properties share one reference graph. Node size follows degree, color identifies ontology kind, and dense links form topology communities.
map.canvasDescription: Interactive ontology catalog topology with {nodes} nodes and {edges} relationships. Selected: {selected}. Use arrow keys to pan, plus or minus to zoom, and zero to fit.
map.communityHint: {count} link communities - drag nodes or canvas - wheel to zoom
map.footer: Node color identifies ontology kind, size represents degree, and neutral hulls group topology communities.
map.inspectorDefault: Weighted relationships form {count} topology communities while high-degree hubs remain central.
map.interactionValue: Drag, zoom, search, and full screen

graph.navigationHint: Select a neighboring ObjectType to move through the registry. Relationship details remain visible in the inspector.
